memories.subject: owner
memories.name: release-notes
memories.description: Send release notes by DM, not in the channel
memories.body:
DM the release notes to the owner when a tag is pushed.
Why: channel posts get missed.
How to apply: after pushing a tag, send the summary as a direct message.

memories.subject: general
memories.name: release-note-format
memories.description: Release notes: bullet points, one line each, user-facing changes first
memories.body:
Write release notes as bullet points, one line per change, user-facing changes before internal ones.
Why: users skim them.

memories.subject: owner
memories.name: release-day
memories.description: Releases go out on Tuesdays
memories.body: Tag and publish releases on Tuesday mornings JST, so there is a full week to fix regressions.

memories.subject: general
memories.name: commit-style
memories.description: Use Conventional Commits
memories.body:
Commit messages start with feat:, fix:, docs: or refactor:.
Why: the changelog is generated from them.

memories.subject: general
memories.name: client-commits
memories.description: No AI attribution lines in commits to client repositories
memories.body:
Commits to client repositories (Acme and others) carry no co-author or AI attribution lines.
Why: the clients' policy.

memories.subject: general
memories.name: package-manager
memories.description: Use pnpm for the web console, never npm
memories.body:
Run pnpm install and pnpm build in web/console.
Why: the lockfile is pnpm-lock.yaml.

memories.subject: general
memories.name: go-tests
memories.description: Write table-driven Go tests
memories.body: Prefer table-driven tests with t.Run subtests for edge cases.

memories.subject: general
memories.name: gofmt
memories.description: Run gofmt before committing Go code
memories.body:
Format Go code with gofmt before every commit.
Why: CI rejects unformatted files.

memories.subject: owner
memories.name: deploy-window
memories.description: No production deploys on Friday
memories.body:
Do not deploy to production on Fridays.
Why: nobody is around on the weekend to roll back.

memories.subject: general
memories.name: migrations
memories.description: Database migrations must be reversible
memories.body:
Every database migration ships with a down migration.
Why: we had to roll back twice in 2025.

memories.subject: owner
memories.name: force-push
memories.description: Ask before force-pushing a shared branch
memories.body: Never force-push a branch someone else works on without asking first.

memories.subject: owner
memories.name: answer-length
memories.description: Keep answers short; lead with the result
memories.body: Lead with the outcome in one sentence, details after.

memories.subject: owner
memories.name: emoji
memories.description: No emoji in messages to the owner
memories.body: Plain text only, no emoji in messages to the owner.

memories.subject: owner
memories.name: ui-review
memories.description: Show screenshots when changing the console UI
memories.body: Attach before and after screenshots for every console UI change.

memories.subject: general
memories.name: docs-language
memories.description: Write new docs in English only
memories.body: New documentation is English only, no Chinese or Japanese.

memories.subject: general
memories.name: pr-description
memories.description: PR descriptions say how to test locally
memories.body: Every pull request description includes the behavior change and how to run it locally.

memories.subject: general
memories.name: dependencies
memories.description: Ask before adding a new dependency
memories.body:
New third-party packages need the owner's OK.
Why: license review.

memories.subject: general
memories.name: secrets
memories.description: Never paste API keys into chat; use the vault
memories.body: API keys and passwords go into the vault, never into chat or config files in the repo.

memories.subject: owner
memories.name: time-format
memories.description: Write times in JST with the date
memories.body: When mentioning a meeting or deadline time, write it in JST with the date, like 2026-11-03 10:00 JST.

memories.subject: owner
memories.name: email-style
memories.description: Draft emails with the ask in the first line
memories.body: Put the request in the first line of every email draft, context after.
